neighbours.mechanism_note: Similar symptoms, different cause. Sandhoff disease, adult form: lysosomal storage (degradation inside the lysosome fails) (via MONDO:0002561 lysosomal storage disease). leukodystrophy, hypomyelinating, 23, with ataxia, deafness, liver dysfunction, and dilated cardiomyopathy: primary hypomyelination (myelin is never properly formed; PLP1 / PMD spectrum, POLR3) (via MONDO:0030514 MONDO label 'leukodystrophy, hypomyelinating, 23, with ataxia, deafness, liver dysfunction, and dilated cardiomyopathy'). No shared causal gene; phenotype similarity simGIC 0.20. Assets and trial designs do not transfer between them without expert review. Reactome: no shared specific pathway between the causal genes.
